title: An experience biking in Seville
text: Great day in Seville. The weather was crisp and cool. Although there was a huge fun run occurring in the beautiful area we were trying to bike through, the guide found ways to respect them and still move us through them. Good day
author: Cynthia T

title: E bike tour
text: Constance was an excellent tour guide. She was very attentive and took her time explaining things to us.  I would highly recommend her for this tour ir any other tour where she is the guide.
author: 288lorieb

title: Electric Bike Tour-Amazing!!
text: Costanzo was a wonderful tour guide. She is knowledgeable and friendly.  She is easy to talk to and kept us happy and safe the entire time.  It’s a wonderful way to see the city.
author: jessicahO1428CM

title: Great way to learn more about Seville while taking in the sights.
text: We did a private 2 hour e-bike tour of Seville which my 16 yr old son and me both enjoyed a lot. The tour covered the main sites and our guide, Costanza, was very knowledgeable and share interesting historical background about the sites we were visiting which made us gain a better understanding of Sevilles history. She also gave us some recommendations of things to do while our cycling which led to a lovely dinner in Triana that evening. I would recommend doing this on the first day of a visit as it is a great way to get to know the city.
author: Acjd_london
